LanguageData.ABY_CraftRiftButcherSigil.label: forge rift butcher sigil
LanguageData.ABY_CraftRiftButcherSigil.description: Compresses horde fragments, residue, plasteel and spacer hardware into a severance-routing sigil. The result does not call another army; it calls the line-breaker that tests whether the colony can survive a surgical melee breach before Dominion access.
